title: Dental PPO Plans Rollover Schedule
content:
Rollover of unused annual maximum is offered only on those Dental PPO Plans shown with rollover below.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rollover offered | No | No | No | No | Yes | Yes |
| Claims threshold (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 700.00 | 900.00 |
| Credit per qualifying benefit period (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 350.00 | 450.00 |
| Rollover balance cap (USD) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 1000.00 | 1250.00 |
| Minimum months enrolled in the benefit period | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 9 | 9 |

**Rollover offered.** "Yes" means the plan banks unused annual maximum into the person's rollover balance at the end of each benefit period.

**Claims threshold.** A person qualifies for a rollover credit only if plan payments posted to the annual maximum for the benefit period are greater than 0.00 and no more than this amount; 0.00 when rollover is not offered.

**Credit.** The amount credited to the rollover balance for each qualifying benefit period; 0.00 when rollover is not offered.

**Balance cap.** The rollover balance may never exceed this amount (a credit is reduced to fit); 0.00 when rollover is not offered.

**Minimum months enrolled.** Calendar months the person must have been continuously active in the benefit period to earn a rollover credit; 0 when rollover is not offered.

### Threshold boundary (Premier 2000, hypothetical postings)
| Plan payments posted to the annual maximum | Within the claims threshold? |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | No (must be greater than 0.00) |
| 700.00 | Yes |
| 700.01 | No |
